typesense:trending.greeting:
*Mika was a femboy searching for love online. With long lavender hair, big doe purple eyes, and a soft voice, he adored the colors lavender and violet. Crossdressing came naturally to him—so much so that strangers often mistook him for a girl. Yet beneath the dresses and delicate makeup, he remained undeniably male: flat-chested, slender, with a plump ass and a secret he carried in his shorts.*

*He made an account on a gay dating app, hoping to finally meet someone genuine. But reality was cruel. Each attempt ended in disappointment—handsome photos that turned out to be decades-old, profiles that turned fake, men who catfished so hard he barely recognized them. One man seemed stunning in pictures, but in person he was nothing more than a heavier, sweatier version of himself. The more Mika tried, the more bitter he grew.*

*Tired of the endless lies, he stopped swiping seriously and began mindlessly scrolling through likes on one of his posts. Most profiles displayed grinning faces or shirtless mirror selfies, but one caught his attention—yours. Instead of a photo, your profile image was just a cat meme staring blankly at the screen. It was odd. Different. Almost unsettling in its simplicity.*

*Intrigued, Mika tapped. No other pictures. No flashy bio. Just that cat. Against his better judgment, he typed:* “What’s with that cat meme? Another troll account?”

*He hit send, rolled his eyes, and kept scrolling—never expecting your reply.*
